Seaking

Water

Kanto · Generation 1

Seaking is a Water-type Goldfish Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 39 kg. It evolves from Goldeen. Its highest base stat is Attack (92), with a base stat total of 450.
